notes.title: Update On Remake and Future Plans
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I wanted to take a moment to share a quick update on the progress of the game's remake. Things are moving along well, and I'm excited about the direction the project is heading. That said, I’m still in the early stages of development, with many core systems being reworked from the ground up.

First, I want to sincerely thank all of you for your patience and continued support. I know the original release didn’t meet expectations, and I truly appreciate everyone who gave the game a try despite its rough initial state. Your feedback and encouragement have been incredibly motivating.

Going forward, I’ll be releasing monthly development updates to showcase some of the new models, features, and improvements coming to the remake. These updates will give you a closer look at what’s being built and how the game is evolving.

As a reminder, everyone who already owns the current version will receive the remake for free when it's released. This is my way of showing appreciation to the early supporters who stuck with the project.

One of my goals with this remake is to build more of the game's systems from scratch — including features like proximity voice chat and procedural level generation — to ensure a more unique and polished experience.

Thanks again to everyone who has supported the game so far. I’m looking forward to creating something much better, and I can’t wait to share more with you in the coming months. If you would like to leave feedback feel free to join our Discord.

— TOGames

notes.title: Lights Out Update
notes.notes:
The Lights Out Update
We hope you are all enjoying Forsaken Facilities! We hope that the lights out update will add some more pressure to the players, and increase tension while you are exploring the facilities. If you ever have any bugs you would like to report or suggestions to improve the game feel free to join our Discord. Thank you to everybody that has given Forsaken Facilities a try!


Update Features

A new timer has been added to increase the pressure while searching through facilities
The more days you survive the shorter your timer will become
When the timer expires all of the lights in the facility will turn off
Added a flashlight to help players navigate the facility when the lights are off

notes.title: Optimization and Bug fix
notes.notes: Small optimizations were made to increase performance

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.notes:
Added a new setting in the main menu to set the windowed mode. This should help players that were having display issues correct those issues.

Reworked Discord Rich Presence implementation.

notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Forsaken Facilities is releasing at midnight

Thank you everybody for the support throughout development, and thank you to all players who will be giving Forsaken Facilities a try. 

Roadmap
With the release being an early access release we thought it would be best to let everybody know the plans for the next couple months. Some features we are planning to release within the next month are a Steam leaderboard that tracks how many days each player has survived and displays who the best players are. Another key feature we are planning to release within the next month is an in game store. This feature will hopefully incentivize players to continue playing. The store will feature equipment that can be very beneficial to the players when used correctly. 

Once these key features are released our next goal is to release another facility within the first two months of the release. We will not release any details on the next facility at this moment but there will be a few easter eggs added to the game when we are closer to releasing the update. 

Bug Reporting
Temporarily we will be using a Google Form for bug reporting. Hopefully we will have a better system in place within the first couple of weeks of release for bug reporting. We are also open to emails which can be found in the about section of our Steam page. 

Bug Reporting Form

Thank you again for playing Forsaken Facilities!!!
